description_en: Creates message routing relationships between topics
description_zh: 调用该接口新建Topic间的消息路由关系
kebab_example: aliyun iot create-topic-route-table --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --src-topic /x7aWKW90000/testDataToDataHub/user/update --dst-topic example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTopicRouteTable

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The source topic, which is the topic that is subscribed to. Example: `SrcTopic=/x7aWKW9****/testDataToDataHub/user/update`
parameters.name: src_topic

parameters.help_en: The list of destination topics, which are the topics that subscribe to messages from **SrcTopic**. Specify this parameter in the array format even if only one topic exists. Example: `DstTopic.1=/x7aWKW9****/deviceNameTest1/user/add`, `DstTopic.2=/x7aWKW9****/deviceNameTest2/user/delete`
parameters.help_zh: 目标Topic列表，即从**SrcTopic**订阅消息的Topic列表。即使只有一个Topic，也使用数组格式。如`DstTopic.1=/x7aWKW9****/deviceNameTest1/user/add`，`DstTopic.2=/x7aWKW9****/deviceNameTest2/user/delete`
parameters.name: dst_topic
